About our team

Technology | Enterprise Technology Services | Operational Capability | Enforcement Communications

The Operational Capability Branch (OCB) enables operational capability through the provision, support and sustainment of technology to operational areas responsible for Australian Border Force (ABF) frontline activities, in line with the ABF Service Delivery Framework and Capability Lifecycle Management Model.

The Enforcement Communication Section (EC) within the Operational Capability Branch, Enterprise Technology Services Division, contributes to the preservation of Australia's border integrity, delivering, maintaining and enhancing Australian Border Force (ABF) operational enforcement communications networks and equipment. Enforcement communications capabilities are critical to ABF operational effectiveness, security and officer/safety.

The EC team is responsible for the design, installation, support, maintenance and upgrades to operational Enforcement Communications equipment, including Ultra High Frequency (UHF) systems at airports and seaports, networks in regional centres including the Torres Strait where there is an operational ABF presence.

The team is also responsible for deployable tactical satellite communications systems and the delivery of projects funded under the Capital Investment Program.

Please visit our website for more information about the Department of Home Affairs or Australian Border Force.

Our ideal candidate

  • The Candidate will have the ability to, or be willing to quickly acquire, technical expertise in the enforcement communications capabilities that are managed by the Section. Specifically, UHF, Very High Frequency (VHF) radio and other communications equipment to be used in remote areas, such as satellite communication and 4G
  • The candidate will have an interest in and or experience with computer networking technologies and procedures desirable for UHF and Radio Over IP (ROIP) installation/troubleshooting
  • The Enforcement Communications Maintenance Officer will work directly to the Enforcement Communications Technical Officer and with other members of the team and external service providers for Enforcement Communications support and maintenance.
  • The role will also be required to contribute to contract management through logistical support and fault and asset management. The position holder will also assist with management of the Enforcement Communications Lab.
  • The candidate will have the opportunity to align and work with subject matter experts for Enforcement Communications within the Section to assist with maintenance and logistical asset support across Australia.

  • Contribute to logistical support, including but not limited to:
    • asset management database
    • encryption key uploads
    • upgrade of equipment
    • equipment shipping/tracking
    • management of storage and equipment, including disposal planning
  • Maintain UHF related records including shipment of assets and equipment stored in the UHF Lab in accordance with Departmental record keeping requirements
  • Support management of the Enforcement Communications Lab and warehouse and ensure compliance with work, health and safety regulations, including housekeeping.

In certain circumstances, an Employment Suitability Clearance (ESC) may be required in addition to, or in lieu of, an Onboarding Check, which will be determined by the delegate as necessary.

title: CIVIL CONSTRUCTION PROJECT MANAGER
description:
CIVIL CONSTRUCTION PROJECT MANAGER



Landmark Solutions Ltd. (Landmark) is growing, and we’re looking for a Civil Construction Project Manager to help build what comes next. Join a team that values practical expertise, fresh ideas, and quality work, with the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution as we expand. This role is for a practical construction professional who understands how projects are built and can lead teams through successful project delivery. Our portfolio includes bridges, water infrastructure, marine works, earthworks, utilities and other civil construction.

The successful candidate will work closely with construction leaders, field teams, estimators, clients, suppliers, and subcontractors across a diverse portfolio that may include bridges, water infrastructure, marine works, earthworks, utilities, and other civil construction.



WHO WE ARE

Landmark is a growing, multifaceted company with a dedicated team of professional and support staff, working together to provide our clients with high quality, innovative solutions in the safest, most efficient way. Our professional expertise includes project management, construction, forestry services, environmental services, ecosystem restoration, and marine construction. From concept to completion, we listen carefully to our clients and develop innovative, cost-effective solutions and provide high-quality service with a focus on safety and the protection of environmental and cultural values.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Civil Construction Project Manager will lead civil and infrastructure projects from award through completion and close-out, taking ownership of safety, cost, schedule, quality, productivity, contracts and client relationships. You will manage project planning, budgets, scheduling, contract administration and resource coordination, working closely with construction leaders, field teams, estimators, clients, suppliers and subcontractors. This is a full-time, permanent position based in Salmon Arm, with regular travel to project sites as required. Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead projects with safety as a core priority and ensure Landmark health, safety, environmental, quality, and project-management systems are effectively implemented.
  • Take ownership of project outcomes, including safety, financial performance, schedule, productivity, quality, contractual compliance, and client satisfaction.
  • Review contracts, drawings, specifications, estimates, schedules, and tender assumptions at project handover and translate them into an effective Project Execution Plan.
  • Develop and maintain project budgets, cost forecasts, cash-flow awareness, commitments, productivity tracking, and estimate-at-completion reporting.
  • Develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules, resource-loaded lookaheads, critical-path activities, and recovery plans where required.
  • Coordinate Landmark crews, subcontractors, suppliers, equipment, materials, and other project resources to meet project objectives.
  • Identify and manage project risks, opportunities, scope changes, delays, claims, notices, and commercial issues in accordance with contract requirements.
  • Prepare and manage change orders, pricing, progress claims, forecasts, project reporting, and supporting documentation.
  • Lead project, site, subcontractor, and client meetings and ensure decisions, commitments, risks, and follow-up actions are clearly documented.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, regulators, and internal teams.
  • Ensure project records, drawings, correspondence, field documentation, quality records, and contract administration are accurate and current.
  • Support procurement of materials, subcontracted work, and project services in coordination with Landmark teams.
  • Work closely with Estimating and Construction teams during project handover, execution, close-out, and lessons-learned reviews.
  • Provide practical leadership to project teams, resolve issues proactively, and escalate material risks or decisions when required.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Minimum 5+ years of progressive construction experience, including direct responsibility for managing civil, infrastructure, industrial, or comparable contractor-side projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project cost, schedule, contracts, subcontractors, field execution, reporting, and client relationships.
  • Practical knowledge of civil construction methods, sequencing, equipment, crews, productivity, constructability, and site execution.
  • Experience with bridges, stream restoration including rip rap placement, marine works, earthworks, retaining walls-Arches MSE/GRS, utilities, roadwork, concrete, or comparable infrastructure is an asset.
  • Strong understanding of drawings, specifications, tender documents, contracts, subcontracts, change management, and project risk.
  • Familiarity with Canadian or comparable North American civil construction practices, including contract administration, labour/equipment costing, subcontractor management, safety requirements, and commercial expectations.
  • Knowledge of MoTT, MMCD, CCDC, or similar contract and specification frameworks is considered an asset.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, with the ability to monitor budgets, forecasts, productivity, commitments, changes, and project performance.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to set priorities, coordinate multiple workstreams, and meet demanding deadlines.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, build positive working relationships, resolve conflict, and communicate professionally with clients and project stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment while collaborating effectively with field, estimating, accounting, safety, and leadership teams.
  • Strong commitment to workplace safety, environmental responsibility, quality, and professional project delivery.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Experience with construction project-management, scheduling, cost-control, or ERP software is an asset.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in both field and office environments.
  • Valid BC Class 5 Driver’s Licence with a clean driving record and the confidence to drive safely in a variety of road conditions.
  • Projects are located throughout Western Canada; candidates must be willing to travel to project sites and work shift-based schedules when required.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE PATHWAYS

Landmark values practical construction knowledge and recognizes that strong project managers enter the profession through different pathways. Candidates may qualify through either:

  • Post-secondary education in construction management, civil engineering technology, engineering, business or a related discipline, together with relevant civil construction experience; OR
  • An equivalent combination of substantial civil construction, field, trade, supervisory, superintendent, coordinator, or project management experience



Experienced civil construction professionals who progressed into project management through field, supervisory or construction leadership roles are encouraged to apply.

WHAT WE OFFER

Landmark is centrally located in the city of Salmon Arm, with a population of ~19,000, Salmon Arm has all the amenities you will find in larger centres in the BC interior. Located on beautiful Shuswap Lake, the area offers an abundance of outdoor recreation opportunities. You will have access to lakes, hiking trails, camping, world class fly fishing, mountain biking, back-country skiing and three different ski resorts within an hour’s drive. It’s a great place to live, work and play.

We provide:

  • Salary ranges from $85,000 to $110,000 per year, depending on qualifications, and experience.
  • Health Spending Plan
  • A company matched RRSP program.
  • Flexible time off.
  • Career growth and professional development.
  • Direct exposure to a diverse range of civil, bridge, water, marine and infrastructure projects.
  • Opportunity to influence project delivery, construction planning and continuous improvement within a growing multidisciplinary company.
  • A collaborative environment with direct access to project and company leadership.



WORK ELIGIBILITY

Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada. Landmark is not offering immigration sponsorship for this position.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter through Landmark Solutions' online careers portal: All resumes will be handled in confidence.

In your application, highlight the types and approximate values of civil or infrastructure projects you have managed, your responsibilities for project delivery, and the project management systems or tools you have used.



Deadline to apply: Available immediately, open until filled.

For more information on who we are and examples of the work we do, visit our website at

We thank all those who apply, however, only those applicants selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: Technical Lead - MLOps
description:
Technical Lead ML Platform & MLOps (E3):

Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 6+ years

Build the Platform Behind AI :

We are looking for a Technical Lead ML Platform & MLOps to help build the next generation of infrastructure that powers machine learning.

This is not a conventional MLOps operations role. You will work on some of the hardest engineering problems at the intersection of Machine Learning, Distributed Systems, Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, Cloud, Developer Platforms and SRE.

The platform you build will enable Data Scientists and ML Engineers to move from an idea to production faster: Code - Features - Distributed Training - Experimentation - Model Registry - Deployment - Inference - Observability.

You will have the opportunity to design and build foundational ML platform capabilities used across multiple ML teams, influence platform architecture, solve large-scale infrastructure challenges, and establish engineering standards for how ML workloads are built and operated.

We are looking for a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys building platforms, debugging complex distributed systems, and simplifying infrastructure for hundreds of ML and engineering users.

What You Will Own :

- Architect, build and evolve scalable ML Platform and MLOps capabilities for large-scale production workloads.

- Create self-service infrastructure that allows Data Scientists and ML Engineers to train, experiment, deploy and operate models without managing underlying infrastructure.

- Design reusable platform abstractions, SDKs, APIs and tooling that dramatically improve ML developer productivity.

- Build systems for reproducibility, lineage, versioning, governance and lifecycle management across ML workflows.

- Drive architecture and technology choices for ML infrastructure.

Distributed Training & GPU Infrastructure :

- Build infrastructure for large-scale distributed training across CPU and GPU clusters.

- Design and operate multi-node and multi-GPU training environments.

- Work with distributed computing frameworks such as Ray or equivalent technologies.

- Build intelligent scheduling, resource isolation and autoscaling capabilities for ML workloads.

- Improve utilization of expensive GPU infrastructure through scheduling, workload optimization and capacity management.

- Design fault-tolerant training systems with checkpointing, retries and recovery mechanisms.

ML Workflow & Training Platform :

- Build a world-class training platform supporting the complete ML development lifecycle.

- Design scalable orchestration for training, feature engineering, validation and deployment workflows.

- Build reusable workflow components using technologies such as Airflow, Ray and Kubernetes.

- Improve scheduling, dependency management, execution isolation and reliability for thousands of ML workloads.

- Enable experimentation across different compute environments without exposing infrastructure complexity to users.

MLOps & Model Lifecycle:

- Build end-to-end ML lifecycle capabilities covering: Experimentation - Training - Validation - Model Registry - Deployment - Monitoring - Retraining.

- Build experiment tracking and model management using MLflow or equivalent technologies.

- Enable reliable model versioning, approval, rollout and rollback.

- Build automated model validation and production-readiness workflows.

- Enable reproducible ML workflows across development, staging and production environments.

Model Serving & AI Infrastructure:

- Build highly scalable infrastructure for real-time, batch and asynchronous model inference.

- Design model-serving platforms running on Kubernetes and GPU infrastructure.

- Optimize serving systems for latency, throughput, availability and cost.

- Explore and adopt technologies such as Ray Serve, NVIDIA Triton, vLLM, SGLang or equivalent platforms where appropriate.

- Enable production deployment of traditional ML, deep-learning and emerging AI/LLM workloads.

Platform Reliability & Observability:

- Treat ML infrastructure as a production-grade distributed platform.

- Define and drive SLIs, SLOs, availability and reliability standards for ML platform services.

- Build deep observability across infrastructure, pipelines, training workloads and inference systems.

- Troubleshoot challenging production issues spanning Kubernetes, GPU workloads, distributed systems, networking, storage and ML pipelines.

- Drive root-cause analysis and systematically eliminate recurring operational issues.

- Design for high availability, fault tolerance and graceful recovery.

Cloud, Kubernetes & Infrastructure:

- Design scalable compute, networking and storage infrastructure for ML workloads.

- Build and operate ML systems on Kubernetes and cloud platforms.

- Automate infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.

- Build secure, isolated and reproducible runtime environments.

- Drive infrastructure efficiency through autoscaling, workload placement and cost optimization.

ML Developer Experience:

- Build developer-facing platforms, SDKs, APIs and abstractions.

- Reduce the time required to move an ML experiment into production.

- Eliminate repetitive infrastructure work for Data Scientists and ML Engineers.

- Build standardized templates and paved roads for ML development.

- Improve debugging, discoverability and observability of ML workloads.

- Enable teams to focus on models and business problems rather than infrastructure.

Technical Leadership:

- Own architecture and technical direction for major ML Platform initiatives.

- Lead complex system-design discussions and technical reviews.

- Convert ambiguous problems into scalable platform solutions.

- Drive engineering excellence across reliability, scalability, performance and maintainability.

- Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar of the team.

- Influence architecture across ML, Data, Platform, SRE and Infrastructure teams.

- Evaluate emerging technologies and make pragmatic build-vs-buy decisions.

- Take critical systems from concept through architecture, implementation and production adoption.

What We Are Looking For:

Must Have:

- 6+ years of strong hands-on software/platform engineering experience.

- Strong programming skills in Python.

- Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers and Linux.

- Experience building or operating large-scale distributed systems or platform infrastructure.

- Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure including compute, storage and networking.

- Experience building production-grade CI/CD and automation platforms.

- Experience with workflow orchestration such as Apache Airflow or equivalent systems.

- Experience with ML lifecycle tooling such as MLflow or equivalent platforms.

- Strong understanding of ML training and deployment workflows.

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.

- Strong debugging and production troubleshooting skills.

- Experience building systems with monitoring, logging, metrics and alerting.

- Strong fundamentals in system design, reliability and distributed computing.

Strong Differentiators:

- Ray or other distributed computing frameworks.

- Distributed or multi-node ML training.

- GPU and multi-GPU infrastructure.

- Kubernetes-based ML platforms.

- ML training platforms used by multiple teams.

- Model serving and inference infrastructure.

- GPU scheduling and utilization optimization.

- Large-scale workflow orchestration.

- ML platform developer experience.

- Infrastructure cost and performance optimization.

- Feature platforms or feature stores.

Good to Have:

- Databricks, SageMaker, Vertex AI or similar ML platforms.

- Model monitoring, data drift and automated retraining.

- NVIDIA Triton, Ray Serve, vLLM or SGLang.

- LLM training/inference and LLMOps.

- Vector databases and retrieval infrastructure.

- Model governance and lineage.

- OpenTelemetry, Grafana or similar observability ecosystems.

The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here:

- You enjoy going below the abstraction.

- You don't just know how to deploy a model using a managed service you want to understand and improve what happens underneath it.

- You are equally comfortable discussing: Python, Kubernetes, Distributed Systems, GPUs, ML Training, CI/CD, MLOps, Production Reliability.

- You can take an ambiguous infrastructure problem, design the architecture, build the critical pieces, debug it under production load and create a platform that other engineers love using.

- Most importantly, you want to build foundational infrastructure that changes how ML engineering is done at scale.

title: QA Batch Review Specialist
description:
Position Summary

Woodstock Sterile Solutions is seeking a Batch Review Specialist to perform comprehensive quality review of batch records and supporting documentation. This role helps ensure records are complete, accurate, and compliant with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), Good Documentation Practices (GDP), company procedures, specifications, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The Batch Review Specialist prioritizes records based on cycle time, customer expectations, and business needs; tracks corrections, exception reports, and required testing; and supports timely batch disposition and release decisions. The role works closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and clients to resolve documentation and process issues and support the release of product for distribution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review batch documentation and in-process testing completed by Manufacturing personnel for completeness, accuracy, and compliance.

  • Compile complete batch records by collecting documentation from multiple sources, including production and laboratory records.

  • Prioritize batch records for review and maintain current status, including corrections, exception reports, and testing required for release.

  • Perform final quality approval and release of product for shipment when requirements are met; reject product lots when specifications or release requirements are not met, as appropriate.

  • Ensure batch record reviews and releases are properly completed and documented; identify and drive resolution of documentation or batch record issues to support timely release.

  • Coordinate with Supply Chain, QAPM, and clients regarding Certificates of Analysis (COAs) needed for batch record release; generate Certificates of Conformity as required.

  • Maintain effective communication with management, associates, and external clients regarding batch record questions, issues, and concerns; participate in client calls to provide release and batch-record updates.

  • Maintain data integrity and comply with company SOPs, specifications, cGMP, GDP, and applicable FDA, EU, JP, cGxP, and OSR requirements; maintain current knowledge of relevant requirements and serve as a plant resource.

  • Support regulatory, customer, and internal audits through document review and retrieval, audit participation, and preparation or review of audit tasks.

  • Identify deviations and non-compliances and report them to Manufacturing and/or MQA as appropriate; actively participate in resolving documentation and process issues.

  • Review and approve minor investigations, non-conformances, and deviations in MasterControl, as assigned.

  • Support regulatory investigation teams, including investigations involving Field Alert Reports or product withdrawals, through document review and retrieval.

  • Maintain the effectiveness of applicable Quality System components; identify, evaluate, and manage product-quality risks and communicate relevant risk policies and processes.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Associate of Science degree, a two-year technical degree, or relevant experience in manufacturing, Quality Assurance, or a Quality Control laboratory; a Bachelor of Science degree is a plus.

  • Four years of directly applicable experience in an FDA-regulated industry, such as pharmaceutical, medical device, or food manufacturing, or an equivalent combination of education and experience in production, Quality Assurance, or Quality Control.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Excellent documentation skills and strong written and verbal communication.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a demonstrated ability to drive work to completion and results.

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks, work under pressure, and prioritize workload.

  • Ability to work effectively with people across roles, functions, and departments.

  • Ability to interpret instructions provided in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

  • Ability to work independently on projects and routine activities and review reports and records for accuracy and logical consistency.

  • Familiarity with cGMP and safe work practices.

  • Proficiency with common business software, such as word processing, spreadsheets, and database applications, preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to read, write, and speak clear English.

Physical and Work Environment

  • Frequent sitting, standing, walking, reading written documents, using a computer monitor, reaching, talking, writing, and listening.

  • Occasional bending, grasping, climbing ladders or steps, carrying, stooping, kneeling, and crouching.

  • Frequent lifting and/or moving of up to 10 pounds, with occasional lifting and/or moving of up to 30 pounds.

  • Fast-paced, performance-driven, customer-focused, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

Why Join Woodstock Sterile Solutions?

Join a team with more than 50 years of sterile manufacturing and BFS technology experience. In this role, you will help protect product quality and data integrity while supporting responsive batch review, dependable release decisions, and timely service to clients and the people who rely on their products.

title: Senior AI Research Scientist
description:
About the Job :

We are seeking a Senior AI Research Scientist with deep expertise in modern foundation models and advanced neural-network architectures.

The ideal candidate understands large language models, diffusion and flow-based generative models, state-space models (SSMs), Transformer-SSM hybrids, mixture-of-experts systems, synthetic-data training, and distributed neural-network inference.

This is a hands-on research role for someone who can move comfortably between mathematical theory, rigorous experimentation, prototype implementation, and production collaboration.

You will investigate new architectures and training methods while helping build systems that operate efficiently across GPUs, CPUs, NPUs, personal computers, edge devices, private servers, and distributed clusters.

Your work should lead to measurable improvements in model quality, reasoning, latency, throughput, memory use, energy efficiency, privacy, reliability, and total cost of operation.

You will have significant influence over product's long-term technical direction and research roadmap.

Key Research Areas :

- Large language models and multimodal foundation models.

- Transformer alternatives and attention-efficient architectures.

- State-space models, including selective SSMs and Mamba-style architectures.

- Hybrid Transformer-SSM, recurrent, sparse, and modular model designs.

- Diffusion, discrete diffusion, flow matching, and multimodal generative systems.

- Mixture-of-experts models, expert routing, modular networks, and conditional computation.

- Synthetic data, model-generated supervision, self-training, and knowledge distillation.

- Distributed inference across heterogeneous and intermittently available devices.

- Memory-efficient inference, KV-cache management, long-context execution, and model sharding.

- Quantization, sparsity, pruning, low-rank adaptation, and dynamic adapter routing.

- Agentic models, tool use, planning, reasoning, and multi-agent coordination.

- Continual learning, personalization, privacy-preserving learning, and edge AI.

Core Responsibilities :

1. Frontier Model Architecture Research :

- Design, implement, and evaluate new neural-network architectures for language, reasoning, multimodal generation, and agentic workloads.

- Research the strengths and limitations of Transformers, SSMs, diffusion models, recurrent architectures, mixture-of-experts models, and hybrid designs.

- Develop architectures that combine attention, state-space mechanisms, recurrence, memory, sparse routing, retrieval, and modular components where appropriate.

- Explore efficient long-context methods, external and recurrent memory, adaptive computation, speculative execution, and improved reasoning techniques.

- Investigate diffusion and flow-based approaches for text, image, audio, video, structured data, and multimodal generation.

- Translate promising research papers and mathematical concepts into reproducible prototypes and production-relevant experiments.

2. Synthetic Data and Model-Generated Training :

- Design scalable pipelines for creating high-quality synthetic examples, reasoning traces, preferences, critiques, simulations, and task-specific training data.

- Develop teacher-student, self-training, rejection-sampling, curriculum-learning, process-supervision, and knowledge-distillation approaches.

- Evaluate alignment and post-training methods such as supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, and AI-generated feedback.

- Build filtering, scoring, deduplication, provenance, contamination-detection, and quality-control systems for synthetic datasets.

- Study and reduce the risks of feedback loops, bias amplification, hallucinations, overfitting, reward hacking, and model collapse caused by poorly controlled synthetic data.

- Establish methods for combining synthetic, public, licensed, customer-authorized, and human-generated data while maintaining privacy and traceability.

3. Distributed Inference and Neural Systems :

- Develop algorithms that partition, route, and execute neural-network workloads across heterogeneous devices and infrastructure.

- Research tensor, pipeline, expert, sequence, and context parallelism for inference in resource-constrained and geographically distributed environments.

- Design efficient methods for model sharding, layer placement, distributed KV-cache management, cache-aware scheduling, and dynamic workload migration.

- Improve inference across mixed hardware, including data-center GPUs, consumer GPUs, CPUs, NPUs, Apple Silicon, integrated graphics, edge devices, and browser-based runtimes where appropriate.

- Develop routing and scheduling strategies that account for memory capacity, bandwidth, latency, thermal limits, energy use, device availability, privacy rules, and workload priority.

- Create resilient inference methods that tolerate node loss, unreliable connectivity, changing resource availability, and partial system failure.

- Explore decentralized or collaborative neural networks in which multiple devices jointly execute models without requiring all data or model components to reside in one location.

- Advance compression and acceleration methods, including quantization, sparsity, pruning, distillation, speculative decoding, optimized kernels, and hardware-aware model design.

4. Research Evaluation and Scientific Rigor :

- Form clear hypotheses, define baselines, design ablation studies, and run statistically sound experiments.

- Create evaluation suites covering accuracy, reasoning, robustness, safety, privacy, latency, throughput, memory, energy use, resilience, and cost.

- Identify where conventional benchmarks fail to predict real-world performance and develop task-relevant evaluations.

- Analyze quality-versus-efficiency tradeoffs and produce evidence that guides architecture and product decisions.

- Maintain reproducible research code, experiment records, model cards, dataset documentation, and technical reports.

- Monitor relevant research and clearly communicate which developments are promising, immature, or unsuitable for systems.

5. Technical Leadership and Product Collaboration :

- Help define the company's research roadmap, technical strategy, and standards for scientific quality.

- Collaborate with engineering teams to move successful research from prototype to reliable production systems.

- Work with product leaders to connect research goals to customer needs, deployment constraints, and measurable business or social outcomes.

- Mentor researchers and engineers, review experimental designs, and raise the technical quality of the broader team.

- Contribute to patents, peer-reviewed publications, open research, technical demonstrations, grant proposals, and strategic partnerships when appropriate.

- Explain complex research clearly to technical teams, customers, partners, investors, and nontechnical stakeholders.

Required Skills :

- Experience with distributed training or inference systems and parallel-computing frameworks.

- Hands-on work with model parallelism, expert parallelism, distributed KV caches, inference schedulers, or heterogeneous clusters.

- Experience with architectures such as Transformers, selective SSMs, Mamba-style systems, mixture-of-experts models, diffusion models, or hybrid combinations.

- Knowledge of inference engines and optimization stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed, Ray, Triton, CUDA, ROCm, MLX, ONNX Runtime, WebGPU, or similar technologies.

- Experience with quantization, low-rank adaptation, dynamic adapters, pruning, sparsity, speculative decoding, or custom kernels.

- Experience creating or governing synthetic datasets at scale, including quality scoring, safety filtering, provenance, and contamination controls.

- Familiarity with alignment and post-training techniques, including preference optimization, reinforcement learning, AI feedback, red teaming, and safety evaluation.

- Experience with multimodal models spanning language, images, audio, video, documents, or structured data.

- Knowledge of privacy-preserving, federated, decentralized, on-device, or edge machine learning.

- A record of leading ambiguous research projects and helping others turn exploratory work into reliable systems.

Qualifications :

- PhD in computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, applied mathematics, computational science, electrical engineering, physics, or a closely related field; or equivalent research and industry experience.

- Typically 5+ years of relevant research or advanced development experience, including substantial work with modern foundation models or generative AI.

- Deep expertise in at least two of the following: LLM architecture, SSMs, hybrid neural architectures, diffusion or flow-based models, synthetic-data training, model optimization, or distributed inference.

- Strong understanding of the mathematics underlying deep learning, including optimization, probability, linear algebra, numerical methods, sequence modeling, and representation learning.

- Demonstrated ability to convert research ideas into working implementations and evaluate them against strong baselines.

- Advanced proficiency with Python and at least one major machine-learning framework, such as PyTorch or JAX.

- Experience training, fine-tuning, evaluating, or serving large neural networks.

- Understanding of memory, compute, bandwidth, latency, and numerical-precision constraints in modern AI systems.

- Strong experimental judgment, technical writing, and communication skills.

- Evidence of meaningful research impact through publications, patents, open-source contributions, deployed systems, or equivalent technical achievements.

title: Plumbing Apprentice
description:
Plumbing Apprentice

Job Description

Position Overview

We are seeking a motivated Plumbing Apprentice to join our service and installation team. In this hands-on role, you will work alongside experienced Lead Technicians, learning the trade while taking on a growing range of responsibilities, including assisting with installations, drain calls, and, once eligible, maintenance calls. This is a commission-based opportunity with a clear path to expanded duties and earning potential as your skills and credentials grow.

Key Responsibilities

Installations

  • Assist Lead Technicians with plumbing installations, including fixtures, water heaters, piping, and related equipment.
  • Prepare job sites, gather tools and materials, and keep work areas clean and safe.
  • Perform assigned portions of each installation under the direction of the Lead Technician.
  • Learn proper installation methods, code requirements, and quality standards.

Drain Calls

  • Once you have obtained the Drain Cleaner Restricted Endorsement, you will be eligible to perform drain calls.
  • Diagnose and clear drain blockages using company-approved equipment and procedures.
  • Communicate clearly with customers about the problem, the work performed, and any recommended follow-up services.

Maintenance Calls

  • After completing the required training (a minimum of thirty (30) days), you may become eligible to perform maintenance calls.
  • Eligibility is at the Company's discretion and depends on successful completion of training.
  • Identify opportunities during maintenance visits for additional work, including repairs and installations, and present them to customers professionally.
  • Work sold during a maintenance call that results in an installation is shared between the apprentice and the installing plumber.

Compensation Structure

This position is commission-based. Earnings are tied to the revenue assigned to you on installations, drain calls, and maintenance-generated sales.

  • Installations: Revenue is shared between the Lead Technician and the apprentice. Revenue allocation may vary by job, depending on your level of involvement and the responsibilities you perform. The final allocation is determined at the sole discretion of your direct supervisor or management.
  • Drain Calls: Commission is earned on drain call revenue once you have obtained the Drain Cleaner Restricted Endorsement.
  • Maintenance Calls: For sold work that results in an installation, revenue is shared between the apprentice and the installing plumber.
  • Performance Bonus: You have the potential to earn an additional commission percentage based on your performance. Performance standards and the determination of any additional percentage are established and made by the Company.
  • Paid Time Off: Approved paid time off (PTO) and company holidays are paid at an hourly rate.

Specific rates and percentages will be provided in your offer letter or compensation agreement.

Qualifications

  • Interest in building a long-term career in the plumbing trade.
  • Ability to follow instructions, learn quickly, and work well on a team.
  • Willingness to obtain the Drain Cleaner Restricted Endorsement.
  • Ability to lift heavy items, work in tight or awkward spaces, and perform physical labor in varying conditions.
  • Strong communication and customer service skills.
  • Reliable, punctual, and professional.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation preferred.
  • Prior plumbing or construction experience is helpful but not required.

Working Conditions

  • Work is performed at residential job sites, indoors and outdoors.
  • Frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, and lifting.
  • Exposure to varying weather, confined spaces, and plumbing-related materials.

Growth Opportunities

As you gain experience, complete training, and earn credentials, you will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and increase your earning potential.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Position Summary

The Instructional Designer transforms organizational concepts, business processes, and operational workflows into engaging, learner-centered training experiences. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining e-learning modules, instructor-led training materials, and blended learning programs. All learning solutions must align with adult learning principles, enterprise standards, and the company's culture and branding.



Duties and Responsibilities


Curriculum Design and Development

  • Design and develop instructional materials, including interactive e-learning modules, job aids, lesson plans, and facilitator guides for instructor-led, virtual, and self-paced training.
  • Create clear, structured learning experiences that support employee development and operational effectiveness.

Instructional Strategy and Multimedia Integration

  • Apply established instructional design methodologies, including ADDIE and SAM, to develop effective learning solutions.
  • Use modern authoring tools and multimedia elements to create engaging, interactive content that improves learner participation and knowledge retention.

Subject Matter Expert (SME) Collaboration

  • Partner with internal subject matter experts, project leads, and stakeholders to translate technical information, operational procedures, and leadership standards into clear, accessible training materials.
  • Define learning objectives and ensure course content aligns with business needs and performance expectations.

Learning Technology and Content Development

  • Develop, publish, and maintain interactive learning modules using industry-standard tools, including Articulate 360, Microsoft Office, and Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Ensure training materials are compatible with learning management systems (LMS) and cloud-based platforms.

Needs Analysis and Assessment

  • Conduct training needs assessments to identify learning gaps and development opportunities.
  • Create knowledge checks, quizzes, and practical assessments to evaluate learner comprehension, training effectiveness, and knowledge application.

Branding and Content Standards

  • Ensure all training materials, visual assets, and instructional documentation follow FDOT and Florida’s Turnpike Enterprise branding and style guidelines.
  • Maintain a consistent, professional look and feel across all learning materials.

Cloud and Asset Management

  • Organize, maintain, and version-control course files, source materials, media assets, and published training packages within secure cloud storage environments.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and ensure learning assets are accessible and organized for future updates.

Quality Assurance and Prototyping

  • Develop course storyboards, prototypes, and pilot materials to validate instructional approaches before full deployment.
  • Gather stakeholder and learner feedback, test course functionality, and make revisions to improve usability and effectiveness.

Project Management and Stakeholder Communication

  • Manage instructional design projects from initial planning through development, testing, and deployment.
  • Track project milestones, manage competing priorities, meet established deadlines, and provide regular status updates to leadership and stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement

  • Research and incorporate emerging trends in instructional design, learning technology, and adult learning principles.
  • Identify opportunities to improve training content, delivery methods, and the overall learning experience.



Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of instructional design theories, adult learning principles, and curriculum development methodologies.
  • Demonstrated experience with e-learning authoring tools, including Articulate 360, Microsoft Office, and Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Understanding of user experience (UX) principles as they apply to digital learning interfaces and virtual training platforms.
  • Ability to collaborate with subject matter experts and translate complex technical or operational information into clear, engaging learning content.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications for documentation, presentations, and instructional material development.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including instructional writing and the ability to tailor content to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative learning and development team.
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to producing high-quality training materials.


Position Requirements


Education

Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Education, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.


Experience

A minimum of three years of experience in training, including instructional content development and training delivery.

title: Data Engineering, Analytics & Modeling
description:
Job Summary:

The Step2 Company is building a modern data platform on Snowflake, fed by Oracle E-Business Suite and our planning, retail and operations systems. Structured (SQL) and unstructured data land in a medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold), with Fivetran for ingestion and dbt for transformation. This role owns how that data is structured, modeled and exposed, making Snowflake the trusted source for reporting, planning and analytics across the business. You will design the tables, models and semantic layer that finance, supply chain, sales and operations rely on every day.

Job Duties:

  • Pipelines: Build and maintain ELT pipelines using Fivetran and dbt, ingesting SQL sources (Oracle EBS and others) and unstructured data into Snowflake. Organize data through bronze (raw), silver (cleaned and conformed) and gold (business-ready) layers. Includes incremental loads, change capture, dbt tests and scheduling.
  • Fivetran management: Own Fivetran syncs for internal and external data sources: connector setup, schedules, schema changes and failure alerts. Keep transfer costs down by choosing the right sync method per source (sync frequency, incremental vs. full loads, table and column selection, Fivetran vs. native Snowflake loading) and tracking usage against budget.
  • Source system knowledge: Learn the underlying table structures of our ERP and operational systems and map them to clean, documented models.
  • Data quality: Put in place tests, reconciliation checks and monitoring so issues are caught before the business sees them.
  • Performance and cost: Tune queries, warehouses, clustering and storage to keep Snowflake fast and within budget.
  • Data modeling: Design and maintain dimensional models (star schemas, facts, conformed dimensions) in Snowflake for sales, orders, inventory, production and finance.
  • Semantic layer: Work with business teams to capture their terms, definitions, rules and processes, and encode them into semantic models: metrics, relationships, hierarchies, synonyms and business logic. Resolve ambiguous terms (e.g. which "sales" or which date) so that reports, analysts and AI tools get the same deterministic answer to the same question.
  • Validated queries: Build a library of automated, validated queries against the semantic models, with expected results checked on a schedule.
  • Governed data access for tools and agents: Expose semantic models and validated queries through MCP servers to AI assistants and agents. Monitor what they query, how results perform, and where answers go wrong.
  • Power BI migration: Migrate existing Power BI data models into Snowflake semantic models. Repoint Power BI reporting from SQL Server to Snowflake, validating that numbers match before cutover.
  • Front-end evaluation: Research and evaluate modern reporting and analytics front ends, both to complement Power BI and as potential replacements for it. Include natural-language query, embedded analytics and agent-driven tools. Run pilots on the Snowflake semantic layer, compare cost and fit against Power BI, and recommend a path, including a migration plan if a replacement is chosen.
  • Security and governance: Manage roles, access policies and data classification in Snowflake, working with IT Security.
  • Partnering: Work with business users and analysts to turn reporting needs into well-defined models and metrics. Document everything.
  • Collaboration: Work with the Manager, Data Analytics on migrating legacy Power BI and SQL Server reporting, and with the Oracle ERP Solutions Architect on the mapping, meaning and governance of ERP data in Snowflake.

Basic Qualification Requirements:

  • 4+ years in data engineering, data warehousing or analytics engineering.
  • Hands-on Snowflake experience: SQL, warehouses, roles and access control, tasks/streams, and cost management.
  • Advanced SQL and hands-on dbt (models, tests, documentation, incremental builds). Working knowledge of Python for data processing and automation.
  • Experience ingesting data from relational source systems (Oracle, SQL Server) with Fivetran or similar tools, and handling semi-structured and unstructured data (JSON, documents, files). Experience building layered medallion architectures. Understanding of source table structures and keys.
  • Strong data modeling skills: dimensional modeling (Kimball), normalization, slowly changing dimensions, and the trade-offs between them.
  • Experience building a semantic layer or metrics layer, for example with dbt, Power BI semantic models, or Snowflake semantic views. Experience migrating Power BI datasets or reports between data sources (e.g. SQL Server to Snowflake).
  • Ability to explain data concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Oracle E-Business Suite data model experience (OM, INV, AR, GL).
  • Master data management (MDM) experience: customer, item and supplier master data, matching and golden records.
  • Ontology and data dictionary expertise: building business glossaries, entity relationships and shared definitions that feed the semantic layer.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, or exposing data to natural-language query tools and agents.
  • Airflow or similar orchestration tools; Git-based workflows and CI/CD for dbt projects.
  • Experience in manufacturing, consumer products, or retail and e-commerce supply chain data.

Work Environment/Physical Demand:

Hybrid or remote; based in Streetsboro, OH. Office environment. Prolonged computer use. Standard business hours, with flexibility to be reasonably available and respond quickly to critical outages or incidents that stop business operations, especially during peak selling seasons.

Purpose of Job
The Fraud Officer conducts investigations to identify, assess, decision and report on activity that indicates an exposure to financial crimes. Ensures potential threats and investigations are evaluated, documented, managed and escalated by following standard operating procedures. Provides subject matter expertise and oversight of criminal risk by following a disciplined and intelligence-based approach to detection and research of activities and events in alignment with EQ Bank’s fraud program and standards to ensure compliance as well as support trending, analysis and insights generation.
L’agent ou l’agente, lutte contre la fraude, mène des enquêtes pour cerner et évaluer les activités qui présentent un risque de fraude, prendre des décisions à leur égard et les signaler. Le ou la titulaire veille à ce que les menaces et les enquêtes soient évaluées, documentées, gérées et transmises à un niveau supérieur en suivant des procédures d’exploitation normalisées.

  • Monitors and analyzes various information provided through detection systems, tools, reports, or manually to evaluate, investigate and determine required actions.

title: AI/ML Engineer - Large Language Models
description:
Were Hiring | AI/ML Engineer Correlation Engine | Terralogic

Terralogic is looking for an experienced AI/ML engineer to join our team and work on an exciting cybersecurity-focused correlation engine.

This is not a pure ML research role. Youll be building and shipping production AI/ML systems that analyse security events, detect behavioural anomalies, correlate multi-stage attack chains, and help SOC teams make better decisions.

Job location: Bangalore

Notice period: Immediate to 30 days

Required Qualifications:

- 35 years of experience in applied ML / data science, with at least one production system involving anomaly detection, behavioral baselining, or time-series / event-sequence modeling.

- Strong Python and TypeScript/Node.js skills, and comfort working in a backend service this role ships production code inside a Kafka/Redis/MongoDB microservice, not just models.

- Solid grasp of statistics relevant to anomaly detection: rolling baselines, peer-group / cohort comparison, confidence intervals, false-positive rate management.

- Working knowledge of graph data structures and graph algorithms (path finding, community detection, or similar) or strong motivation to apply that to a live entity relationship graph.

- Experience with event-driven or streaming architectures (Kafka, Redis Streams/sorted sets, or comparable) and an understanding of sliding-window / windowed aggregation patterns.

- Comfort reading and reasoning about security telemetry (authentication logs, endpoint events, network flow, cloud audit logs).

- Experience serving open-source LLMs locally/on-prem (e.g., Qwen, Llama) with tools such as vLLM, Ollama, or TGI all AI inference in this stack runs on self-hosted open-source models, not cloud AI APIs.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

- Prior exposure to SIEM, XDR, UEBA, or fraud-detection systems, or familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK-style attack chain modeling.

- Hands-on experience with Wazuh or a similar open-source SIEM/XDR platform its decoders, rules, and correlation engine are a useful reference point for this role.

- Experience with SIGMA detection rules or other vendor-neutral detection rule formats.

- Familiarity with NestJS, MongoDB, and Redis in a microservice environment.

- Experience fine-tuning or prompt-engineering open-source models (Qwen or similar) for classification, summarisation, or reasoning tasks in a security context.

- Exposure to graph databases or graph-analytics libraries (e.g., Neo4j, NetworkX, or similar) applied to security or fraud use cases.

Tech Stack:

- Backend: NestJS / TypeScript microservices, MongoDB (entity graph + event collections), Redis (sliding windows, caching), Kafka (enriched event streams).

- ML / analytics: Python for model development and offline evaluation; statistical and graph libraries as needed; self-hosted open-source LLMs (Qwen family) served locally for classification and reasoning tasks no cloud AI APIs in this stack.

- Open-source security tooling: Wazuh (or similar open-source SIEM/XDR) as a reference implementation for decoders, rules, and correlation patterns.

What Success Looks Like:

- The correlation rule library and entity graph reliably catch multi-stage attack chains (credential theft ? lateral movement ? exfiltration) that no single-event rule would flag, with an explainable reasoning trail for each verdict.

- False-positive rate on correlated incidents stays low enough that SOC analysts trust and act on them without alert fatigue.

- The behavioral/statistical layer (peer-group and individual baselines) is tightly integrated with UEBA scoring, so correlation and behavioral anomaly detection reinforce rather than duplicate each other.

- New correlation rules including SIGMA imports can be added or tuned by the security team without engineering involvement, thanks to the hot-reloadable rule registry you help maintain.

Commitment:

- Candidates should be comfortable with a minimum 18-month commitment.

title: Manager, Corporate Development & Strategy
description:
IRCA Group is an Italian leader in premium ingredients for the pastry, bakery, gelato and chocolate industries, owned by CVC, a global tier-1 private equity firm. From chocolate, chocolate decoration, creams and pastry mixes to specialty inclusions, variegates and fruit purées, we serve artisans and large food manufacturers alike, with 22 manufacturing facilities across Europe, the US and Vietnam and revenue above €1 billion. Our growth has been fueled by targeted acquisitions, including Cesarin, Anastasi and the Sweet Ingredients business carved out from Kerry.

IRCA Group USA LLC is the Group’s US subsidiary and the hub of our Americas business, including Dobla USA, with offices in Duluth, GA and Chicago, IL. The Americas are a priority growth market for the Group, combining organic expansion with an active M&A agenda.

The role

The Manager, Corporate Development & Strategy owns the Americas Medium-Term Plan and acts as the strategic right hand of the CFO and CEO Americas. The role sits at the intersection of finance, strategy and leadership-team execution, with direct visibility to Group leadership and to CVC, the Group's private equity shareholder.

We are requiring someone to work onsite at our plant located in Duluth, GA.

Responsibilities

Medium-Term Plan (MTP)

  • Build and maintain the Americas MTP: the integrated 3–5 year financial and strategic plan covering revenue, margin, capex and cash flow.

  • Run the annual MTP cycle and in-year refreshes, coordinating inputs from Commercial, Operations, Supply Chain and Finance.

  • Translate strategic initiatives into financial targets and track delivery against plan.

Value Creation Plan (VCP)

  • Build the Americas Value Creation Plan: the initiatives, KPIs and EBITDA impact that underpin the investment thesis for the region.

  • Track VCP delivery with initiative owners and report progress to CVC through regular shareholder updates.

Strategy

  • Partner with the CFO and CEO Americas on Group strategy: market and competitor analysis, growth priorities, pricing and portfolio choices.

  • Lead strategic projects end to end, from problem framing and analysis to recommendation and implementation.

  • Prepare strategy materials for the Group, the Board and CVC.

Americas Leadership Team (ALT)

  • Coordinate ALT activities: agenda, priorities, action tracking and follow-up on decisions.

  • Own the monthly ALT deck: collect inputs from functions, shape the storyline and highlight issues requiring decisions.

  • Run the cadence of ALT strategic initiatives, ensuring accountability and progress across functions.

M&A and corporate development

  • Support M&A activities: market screening, target profiling, business cases, valuation and due diligence.

  • Contribute to post-merger integration planning and value-creation tracking.

Why this role

C-suite exposure from day one. Work directly with the CFO and CEO Americas and present to the Americas Leadership Team every month.

Real ownership. Own the plan that drives the division's targets, not a slice of someone else's analysis.

Tier-1 private equity ownership. Work in a business owned by global tier-1 private equity funds, interacting directly with CVC on value creation, strategy and M&A.

International scope. Interact regularly with Group headquarters in Italy and with peers across a global organization.

Clear growth path. A natural step from consulting into industry, with exposure that prepares for senior roles in finance, strategy or general management.

Profile

Experience

  • Around 5 years in management consulting (strategy or operations practice), with a track record on growth strategy, business planning or performance improvement engagements.

  • Exposure to consumer goods, food & beverage, industrials or private equity clients is a plus.

  • Experience with M&A, commercial due diligence or value-creation plans is a strong plus.

Skills

  • Strong financial modeling and business-case skills; comfortable building a multi-year plan from the ground up.

  • Structured problem solving and the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear executive storyline.

  • Excellent PowerPoint and Excel; experience with ERP or BI data is a plus.

  • Confident with senior stakeholders; able to drive cross-functional work without direct authority.

  • Self-starter, comfortable in a lean, fast-moving organization.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics or Engineering; MBA preferred.

  • Italian language skills are a plus.

Irca Group offers career growth opportunities as well as competitive compensation and benefits:
Medical, Dental, & Vision, 401(k) matching, Paid Vacation, and Holidays, Employee Education Tuition Reimbursement Program

title: Full-time Operator I (Landscape)
description:
GENERAL NATURE OF WORK: This position performs semi-skilled work in the Public Service Division. An employee in this class is responsible for performing various tasks associated with the maintenance of streets, traffic, parks, cemeteries, buildings, and vehicles in the City. Duties are performed under the direction of the appropriate Section Leader and/or designee.

EQUIPMENT & JOB LOCATION: This position requires thorough knowledge of equipment operation, including pickup trucks, dump trucks, snowplows, front-end loaders, backhoes, street sweepers, mowers, small power tools, crack sealers, curb machines, jack hammers, utility vehicles, tractors, bobcats, forklifts, sign trucks, signal trucks, bucket trucks, paint machines, hand stripers, safety equipment, and a variety of hand and garden tools. The primary work site is the Municipal Maintenance Facility, City-owned facilities and grounds, and any roadways within the City limits of Beavercreek.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS – EXAMPLES OF DUTIES:

Any one position may not include all of the duties listed nor do the listed examples include all duties which may be found in all positions in this class.

  • Operates a variety of vehicles, machines, and equipment appropriate to job-related tasks.
  • Performs routine maintenance and repairs related to streets, traffic, parks, cemeteries, and facilities.
  • Performs various street maintenance tasks, including street maintenance, drainage, concrete work, snow plowing, utility locating, traffic signal system maintenance, street lighting system maintenance, traffic sign maintenance, and roadway marking and paint maintenance.
  • Performs various grounds maintenance tasks, including mowing, trimming, pruning, aerating, fertilizing, pest control, leaf removal, tree removal and cleanup, and maintaining athletic fields and landscape beds.
  • Sets up work zones and road closures.
  • Removes trash from roadways and other City-owned properties.
  • Assembles, installs, and maintains playground equipment.
  • Cleans and maintains City facilities and empties trash receptacles.
  • Maintains fencing and roofs as necessary.
  • Orders materials and maintains related records.
  • Keeps proper records and work orders for all job-related assignments.
  • Sets up and tears down items needed for special events and community festivals.
  • Repairs and maintains all necessary tools and equipment.
  • Directs the activities of part-time, seasonal, and volunteer personnel.
  • Demonstrates regular and predictable attendance.
  • Performs other duties as assigned, including work in other City divisions as necessary.

ADDITIONAL EXAMPLES OF WORK PERFORMED:

  • Assists in storm clean up.
  • Responds to comments and complaints in a professional manner.

DESIRABLE KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • General knowledge of the operations and maintenance of job-related vehicles, machinery, tools, and equipment.
  • General knowledge of the occupational hazards and corresponding safety precautions necessary for the safe performance of assigned duties.
  • Ability to drive a truck, with or without a trailer.
  • Ability to understand and communicate instructions, both oral and written.
  • Ability to read and understand basic written instructions, material and equipment labels, and hazard and warning notices.
  • Ability to read and interpret maps.
  • Ability to work in confined spaces.
  • Ability to establish a safe work zone.
  • Knowledge of basic math.
  • Ability to complete basic reports and checklists.
  • Ability to work under the direction of the Assistant Superintendent, Section Leader, Operator III, and Operator II.
  • Ability to establish and maintain an effective working relationship with City officials, other City employees, and the general public.

DESIRABLE TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE:

  • High school diploma or equivalent supplemented by some experience in routine maintenance, or any combination of training and experience which provides the desired knowledge, skills, and abilities.
  • Ability to meet Operator I core training requirements in relevant division within specified timeline per the City of Beavercreek Training and Reclassification Policy and Training Matrix.


NECESSARY SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must maintain a valid Ohio Driver License.
  • Must maintain a valid Ohio Class ‘A’ Commercial Driver License with airbrake and tanker endorsements. This license must be obtained within three (3) months of hire date.
  • Ability to work other than normal working hours and to work various shifts as necessary.
  • Must be in good physical condition, i.e., able to pass all required physical exams and drug testing as required by the State of Ohio and/or City of Beavercreek.
  • Ability to grasp, lift, and maneuver hand tools, power tools, equipment, and materials of various weights and sizes, in a manner which is safe and effective in the performance of work.
  • Ability to perform physical functions, including lifting objects, equipment, furniture, supplies, and materials (weighing up to 50 pounds).
  • Ability to climb, bend, balance, and traverse rough ground, including under varied weather conditions.
  • Ability to perform heavy manual labor for an extended period of time in all conditions.


The position will be open until filled, with the first review of applications on November 6, 2026.


The City of Beavercreek requires a pre-employment drug test and physical.

title: BIM-VDC Fabrication Database Specialist
description:
PURPOSE

The BIM-VDC Fabrication Database Specialist builds, maintains and improves the mechanical fabrication content used by project teams in Revit. This position creates project-specific fabrication profiles, tests ITM parts and service palettes, and keeps the database aligned with approved materials, connection methods, and fabrication needs.


This role works closely with Detailers, BIM Technicians, the fabrication shop, procurement, vendors and project teams to resolve content issues and support consistent, accurate workflows. Through careful testing, documentation and quality controls, this position helps ensure accurate modeling, spooling, material lists, and shop and field production across projects. Performs related work as required.

Note this position is based in Ankeny, Iowa, and requires onsite attendance.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The following duties are typical for this job. These are not to be construed as exclusive or all inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned.

  • Build and maintain project-specific Autodesk Fabrication profiles and services for mechanical piping and plumbing systems in accordance with project requirements, approved submittals, and department standards.
  • Create, configure, update and maintain ITM fabrication parts and service palettes for pipe, fittings, valves, specialties, and connections; verify descriptions, sizes, materials, dimensional data, and applicable connector settings.
  • Test parts and services in Revit across expected sizes and use cases. Check placement, routing, connections, graphics, tags, and behavior before releasing content for project use.
  • Validate that fabrication content produces accurate and usable spool information and material data in the department workflow, including STRATUS where applicable; investigate and correct discrepancies.
  • Set up and review profiles for project-specific systems and materials, such as carbon-steel chilled water, no-hub cast-iron sanitary, and stainless-steel domestic water when required by the project.
  • Maintain organized source content, approved versions, change records, test results, and profile documentation so teams can identify the current content and reproduce project setups.
  • Work with detailers, BIM technicians, the fabrication shop, purchasing, vendors, and project teams to resolve content requests and confirm how parts will be procured, fabricated, and installed.
  • Troubleshoot reported ITM, service, profile, and data issues; prioritize corrections with the detailing team and communicate corrections, database changes and potential impacts to active models to the appropriate detailing and project teams.
  • Support the development and improvement to mechanical fabrication content standards, quality checks, version controls and handoff procedures across projects.

MINIMUM EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED TO PERFORM ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Post-secondary technical education in mechanical drafting, BIM/VDC, CAD/Revit, plumbing mechanical systems or construction technology a plus.
  • Minimum of two years of relevant experience in mechanical or plumbing detailing, fabrication content development, pipe fabrication, or a closely related role; equivalent combinations of field, shop, technical training, and software experience will be considered.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical piping and plumbing materials, fittings, valves, joining methods, and construction drawings.
  • Experience using Revit fabrication parts and Autodesk Fabrication content, including ITMs, services, or profiles.
  • Ability to test content systematically, diagnose discrepancies, document changes, and communicate with project and shop teams.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining Autodesk Fabrication CADmep databases, ITM content, service templates, and project profiles.
  • Experience with STRATUS, spool production, bills of material, or fabrication data workflows.
  • Experience with mechanical construction, pipe fabrication, purchasing, or the installation of the systems represented in the database.


MENTAL AND PHYSICAL COMPETENCIES REQUIRED TO PERFORM ESSENTAL FUNCTIONS

  • Strong attention to detail and the discipline to verify content before it is used on a live project.
  • Ability to translate approved project requirements into a usable, consistent fabrication profile.
  • Practical problem-solving skills and sound judgment about when to seek engineering, shop, or project-team input.
  • Ability to manage several content requests, communicate progress, and keep clear records of revisions.
  • Willingness to follow company safety requirements and department standards.


ENVIRONMENTAL ADAPTABILITY

  • This position is based in the Ankeny office and requires on-site attendance.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; occasional lifting of up to 10 pounds.
  • Occasional shop or jobsite visits may involve standing, walking, climbing stairs, and varying temperatures. Required personal protective equipment must be worn.


EQUIPMENT/TOOLS

  • Company-provided computer and assigned software, including Revit, Autodesk Fabrication tools, STRATUS, Navisworks, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Office applications as required for assigned work.

title: Pre-Trial Release Officer (Part-Time)
description:
Purpose of Class

Performs administrative duties to support the Pre-Trial Release program according to Public Safety Assessment level/standards and any additional Court requirements as ordered; supervision of clients released on pretrial supervision, implementation and use of the Public Safety Assessment, performs related work as required.

Primary Function

The primary function of an employee in this class is to perform a variety of administrative and clerical duties to support the Pre-Trial Release programs. The work is performed under supervision of the Adult Probation & Pretrial Director. The principal duties of this class are performed in a public office building.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (will vary by assignment)

  • Compiles and reports criminal history on defendants being arraigned daily for arraignment judge, utilizing appropriate computer programs, NCIC reports, communication with probation officers and other departments and any out of county/ felony (if applicable) information available and inputs information into the Public Safety Assessment application for the Court's review at arraignment for in custody arraignments.
  • Attends court sessions daily to answer questions from Judge on defendant's history and to sign up new clients for pretrial release program according to Public Safety Assessment level/standards and additional Court requirements as ordered;
  • Maintains a caseload of defendants ordered into the pretrial release program and provides them information on program and individual requirements;
  • Opens and maintains files on participating defendants, including required call-ins and related compliance requirements;
  • Enrolls defendants (if opt in) for court date reminders in our text notification system
  • Prepares affidavits of noncompliance;
  • Prepares warrants, as ordered by the Court;
  • Maintains records, digital files, logs, databases, documents, and correspondence and files reports to be kept in Odyssey supervision program
  • Completes data entry for tracking pre-trial release clients into appropriate fields in Odyssey supervision program
  • Tracks new charges on clients and notifies judges issuing warrants as directed;
  • Monitors all no contact orders issued in Bannock County including data entry and follow up;
  • Supervises defendants on pre-trial release, including drug and alcohol testing (if ordered by the Court), monitoring defendant check-in, court date reminders and other conditions of release;
  • Performs random drug and blood alcohol (BAC) tests, as needed;
  • Answers telephone and other inquiries, provides information, routes calls, and distributes mail;
  • Maintains Department and program confidentiality;
  • Maintains and prepares records, reports, logs, and statistical data;
  • Performs all work duties and activities in accordance with County and Department policies, procedures, and safety practices.

Other Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assists other Department personnel as necessary;
  • Performs other related duties as required.

Competency Requirements

Knowledge of:

  • Court and related legal procedures, processes, and terminology;
  • Public Safety Assessment and implementation of such assessment
  • Applicable laws, statutes, codes, and Court and Department policies and procedures;
  • Customer service methods, techniques, and objectives;
  • Current office procedures and methods;
  • Current file and information management system methods and procedures;
  • Operation of standard office equipment, a personal computer, and job-related software;
  • Operation of specialized drug and alcohol testing equipment according to department policy and procedures;
  • English grammar, spelling, punctuation, and composition.

Ability to:

  • Follow written and oral instructions;
  • Maintain records, accounts, logs, reports, documents, correspondence, and related files;
  • Establish communications and working relationships with program participants, attorneys, and court personnel, including under stressful and adversarial conditions;
  • Apply policies and procedures governing pre-trial release, probation, and substance abuse evaluation;
  • Cope with stressful situations calmly, fairly, and tactfully;
  • Operate standard office equipment, including a personal computer with program applications appropriate to assigned duties;
  • Perform basic mathematical calculations;
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, other County employees, judges, and the public;
  • Work independently;
  • Use logical and creative thought processes to develop solutions according to procedures, specifications, and/or instructions and in situations where established procedures do not apply;
  • Perform multiple tasks simultaneously, including handling interruptions, and return to and complete tasks in a timely manner;
  • Perform time management and scheduling functions, meet deadlines, and set project priorities;
  • Communicate effectively, verbally and in writing;
  • Maintain program confidentiality.

Acceptable Experience and Training

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent is required and advanced business office or secretarial coursework is preferred;
  • Bachelors degree in social work, law enforcement, or a related field is preferred; and
  • Two (2) to three (3) years court-related experience is required; or
  • Any equivalent combination of experience and training which provides the knowledge and abilities necessary to perform the work;

Special Qualifications

  • Idaho drivers license is required;
  • Notary Public certification is preferred;
  • Certification to run NCIC reports

Essential Physical Abilities

  • Sufficient clarity of speech and hearing, with or without reasonable accommodation, which permits the employee to discern verbal instructions and communicate effectively in person and by telephone;
  • Sufficient visual acuity, with or without reasonable accommodation, which permits the employee to comprehend written work instructions and process and prepare written and text documents;
  • Sufficient manual dexterity, with or without reasonable accommodation, which permits the employee to operate standard office equipment, a personal computer, and motor vehicle;
  • Sufficient personal mobility, flexibility, strength, and agility, with or without reasonable accommodation, which permits the employee to sit and work at a keyboard for an extended period of time and work in an office environment.

Bannock County is an Equal Opportunity Employer
