• Own the acquisition process and see the results of your work from first contact to signed partnership.

• Present a broad portfolio of solutions, from ticketing to marketing and Cashless services.

• Build strategic partnerships with some of the Czech Republic’s major event organizers.

🤝Recruitment process

  1. Apply: Send your CV with a few sentences on why you’d like to join us.
  2. Get to know each other: a casual call with People Team about your motivation and experience.
  3. Interview with Hiring Manager: Conversation about the role, daily agenda, and expectations.
  4. Meet the rest of the team.
  5. Job offer – If it’s a match, we’ll be happy to welcome you to the team!

👋 Ready to join?

Every year, we sell over 15 million tickets to concerts, festivals, theatre, and more — and every role here helps make that happen. Be part of a team where your work truly connects people with the moments that matter.


—

CZ

🩷 O nás

V PLG Group propojujeme lidi s kulturou – od koncertů, divadla a festivalů až po výstavy a další živé akce po celém Česku a Slovensku.

PLG Czech Republic tvoří tři silné lokální značky s dlouhou tradicí: Ticketportal je na scéně od roku 2002, GoOut od roku 2011, Ticketstream od roku 2001. Naším dlouhodobým cílem je poskytnout partnerům i zákazníkům jednoduchý přístup do všech zákoutí kulturního a sportovního života. Na našich platformách si každý najde akci přesně pro sebe a rovnou si může koupit vstupenky.

Díky zázemí mezinárodní společnosti a know-how tří spojených lokálních týmů máme k dispozici ty nejlepší technologické možnosti. Naše filozofie ale zůstává pořád jednoduchá. Fungujeme otevřeně, kreativně a blízko lidem, kteří kulturu tvoří každý den.


💚 Tvoje role

Jako Acquisition Manager pomůžeš PLG růst tím, že budeš získávat nové pořadatele akcí. Povedeš obchodní proces od prvního oslovení až po podpis smlouvy a budeš představovat řešení podle potřeb jednotlivých pořadatelů.

Co budeš dělat:

• Vyhledávat a oslovovat pořadatele kulturních, sportovních a zábavních akcí na českém trhu.

• Vést akviziční schůzky a představovat ticketingové, marketingové a další služby PLG.

• Zjišťovat potřeby potenciálních klientů a připravovat odpovídající nabídky, kalkulace a smluvní dokumentaci.

• Řídit obchodní pipeline od kvalifikace leadu a follow-upu přes vyjednávání až po podpis smlouvy.

• Koordinovat onboarding a předání nových klientů týmu Account Managementu.

• Sledovat trh a konkurenci, sdílet poznatky s interními týmy a podílet se na rozvoji akvizičního přístupu.

• U zkušenějšího profilu také podporovat kolegy při komplexních jednáních a sdílet know-how.

Koho hledáme:

• Máš přibližně 2–5 let zkušeností v B2B akvizici, business developmentu nebo aktivním prodeji (ideálně v oblasti TECH řešení).

• Nevadí ti aktivně oslovovat nové klienty, zvládáš odmítnutí a umíš udržet tempo i v delším obchodním cyklu.

• Máš dobré prezentační, komunikační a vyjednávací schopnosti a dokážeš porozumět byznysu klienta.

• Umíš pracovat s CRM, vlastní obchodní pipeline a obchodními daty.

• Čeština nebo slovenština je tvůj rodný jazyk a angličtinu ovládáš na úrovni B2.

• Počítáš s cestováním za klienty po ČR a občasnou účastí na akcích mimo běžnou pracovní dobu.

• Zkušenost z eventů, ticketingu, kultury, sportu, e-commerce nebo SaaS je výhodou. Zkušenost se strategickými klienty a jednáním na úrovni C-level je plus.

• Řidičský průkaz skupiny B je výhodou.


🩶 Proč by tě tahle role mohla bavit

• Budeš pracovat na pomezí živých akcí, kultury a technologií.

• Povedeš akvizici od prvního oslovení až po uzavřené partnerství a uvidíš přímý výsledek své práce.

• Budeš představovat široké portfolio služeb — od ticketingu po marketing a Cashless.

• Budeš budovat strategická partnerství s významnými pořadateli akcí v ČR.


🪴 Náborový proces

  1. Přihlas se: pošli nám CV a pár vět o tom, proč chceš k nám
  2. Poznejme se: krátký call s People Teamem o tvojí motivaci a zkušenostech.
  3. Rozhovor s hiring managerem: víc o roli, denní agendě a vzájemných očekáváních.
  4. Poznej zbytek týmu.
  5. Job offer: když to bude match, přivítáme tě mezi nás!

👋 Přidej se k nám!

Každý rok prodáme přes 15 milionů vstupenek na koncerty, festivaly, divadla a další akce – a každá role u nás pomáhá, aby se to stalo. Přidej se k týmu, kde tvoje práce opravdu propojuje lidi s zážitky, které stojí za to.

title: ERP Project Manager - Odoo Platform
description:
About the Role :

We are looking for an ERP Project Manager to lead the end-to-end implementation of Odoo ERP across the organisation. The role involves coordinating business and technical teams, managing project scope and timelines, overseeing implementation activities, and ensuring successful deployment and post-go-live stabilisation. Following the implementation, the candidate will take on responsibility for leading the organisation's ERP Development Competence Centre.

Key Responsibilities :

- Lead the end-to-end Odoo ERP implementation lifecycle, from project initiation and requirements validation through solution design, deployment, and post-go-live stabilisation.

- Develop and maintain project plans covering scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, resources, budget, and delivery priorities.

- Coordinate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, developers, IT teams, and external implementation partners to ensure effective project execution.

- Gather, analyse, and validate business requirements and translate them into functional requirements and ERP implementation plans.

- Oversee ERP configuration, customisation, integrations, data migration, testing, and deployment activities.

- Manage the functional backlog, prioritise requirements, and coordinate change requests based on business value, feasibility, and project objectives.

- Establish project governance processes, including status reporting, review meetings, decision-making mechanisms, and escalation procedures.

- Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies, and drive mitigation plans to minimise delivery delays.

- Monitor project progress against agreed scope, timelines, budget, and quality expectations.

- Coordinate system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, user training, and business readiness activities.

- Ensure data integrity, process alignment, and smooth integration between Odoo ERP and other enterprise applications.

- Drive post-implementation support, issue resolution, process improvements, and system stabilisation.

- Establish documentation, delivery standards, and development processes for ongoing ERP enhancements.

- Build and lead the ERP Development Competence Centre after successful implementation, overseeing future enhancements, technical capability development, and continuous improvement.

Required Skills & Experience :

- 16 years of relevant experience in ERP project coordination, project management, ERP implementation, or enterprise application delivery.

- Hands-on exposure to Odoo ERP implementation, configuration, customisation, or support.

- Understanding of ERP implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, integration, testing, and deployment.

- Familiarity with ERP modules and business processes such as Finance, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, and related operational functions.

- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, stakeholders, vendors, or implementation partners.

- Understanding of project planning, milestone tracking, resource coordination, risk management, and change control.

- Familiarity with data migration, system integration, UAT, deployment, and post-go-live support.

- Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and actionable project deliverables.

- Strong organisational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive delivery.

Good to Have :

- Experience with Odoo technical architecture, APIs, integrations, or custom module development.

- Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall project management methodologies.

- Knowledge of Python, PostgreSQL, and web application architecture used in Odoo environments.

- Experience with ERP vendor management, implementation partner coordination, or enterprise application governance.

- Relevant project management or ERP certifications.

title: Engineering Manager
description:

401k Match, Medical, Dental and Vision Plans for Employees and Families

Our people are the heart of our business. As the world’s largest provider of thermal processing services, Bodycote employs thousands of highly skilled staff around the globe, including some of the best engineers, scientists, and technicians in the industry. Come join our team!

Due to the nature of our business and a heavy industrial market, Bodycote deems this position to be safety-sensitive.

Summary: The Engineering Manager performs essential functions related to the purchasing, installation, and maintenance of thermal processing equipment and the associated infrastructure and facilities in which it operates. The position collaborates with business leaders across the division to drive exceptional performance and executes responsibilities at the direction of the Vice President, Operations to meet customer specifications and standards, including assigning work to other team members as needed

Essential Job Functions (Duties and Responsibilities): The primary duties consist of, but are not limited to the following.

· Coordinate maintenance planning and equipment purchasing with local site leaders and Capital Projects leaders

· Support capital projects as directed in collaboration with the Technical Services organization

· Build strong working relationships with critical equipment and infrastructure suppliers and contractors

· Build and support a strong community of maintenance professionals across the sites, fostering collaboration, innovation, and cross-plant resource support

· Establish guidelines for site-level preventative and predictive maintenance systems and ensure critical spares and maintenance tasks are identified and supported· Ensure maintenance activities are tracked and documented in the CMMS platform/database, including upgrades, repairs, and budgets; continuously monitor MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) and deploy procedures and training to reduce repair times. Report results regularly as a KPI

· Supervise the preparation of regular reports on project progress and special reports addressing unique circumstances or problems, including recommendations for resolution

· Perform responsibilities in a fiscally responsible manner, including those related to the financial function of the business

· Perform other duties as assigned

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

· This position must satisfy ITAR compliance requirements; therefore, candidates must be U.S. Citizens or Permanent Resident Card Holder

· Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent experience in vacuum furnaces and infrastructure required

· Minimum of ten (10) years of maintenance/installation management experience with multi-plant responsibility; demonstrated understanding and ability to apply quality, engineering and maintenance theories and best practices across the business

· Minimum of five (5) years of experience leading large teams of engineers that are decentralized

· Demonstrated experience in PFMEA development and deployment, problem solving (5 why, 8 D, Fault tree analysis, etc.)

· Hands on experience in maintenance of heat treat systems is preferred.

· Troubleshooting and working knowledge of PLCs, hydraulics, pneumatics, etc. is required

· Demonstrated understanding of plant operations and processes is required

· Demonstrated greenfield experience bringing online capital equipment in manufacturing facilities along with implementation of major capital projects

· Must have or be willing to obtain Six Sigma Black Belt

· Demonstrated success implementing or leading world-class processes, such as lean manufacturing

· Excellent communication and partnership skills which are essential for interacting and communicating effectively with key stakeholders at all levels across the company to manage, inform and influence outcomes

· Must be able to read and interpret blueprints, specifications and purchase orders and provide guidance to sites on the same. Considered the expert within the organization and capable of discussions both inside and outside of the organization

· Knowledge and hands on experience of computer applications including Microsoft Suites such as Project, Office, Excel and PowerPoint, CADD.

· Must be a self-directed individual capable of multi-purpose activities

· Must be able and willing to travel up to 75% across North America facilities

Physical & Mental Demands: The following physical and mental demands consist of, but are not limited to the following.

· Must be able to work in a sitting position for extended periods of time (at desk, while driving, and/or on airplane travel) in an office/industrial environment.

· The ability to travel up to 75% via plane and car.

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented AIOps Support Engineer to join our growing global technology team. In this role, you will perform hands-on, manual triage of alarms and monitoring alerts across a large and diverse application portfolio.

The portfolio starts with 50 applications and scales to approximately 320 over two years, spanning various technology stacks, log aggregation tools, and lifecycle dispositions (Invest, Tolerate, Retire, Migrate). - Telemetry and Data Stewardship: Help build and maintain a clean OpenTelemetry-based data backbone; flag inconsistent, noisy, or low-quality alert data to drive it toward a standardized state.

- Proactive Monitoring: Contribute to the shift from reactive incident response toward proactive issue prevention by flagging patterns and gaps in monitoring coverage.

- Ecosystem Tracking: Learn and track the technology stack, architecture disposition, and ownership of each supported application within a growing portfolio.

- Cross-functional Coordination: Coordinate directly with the correct support groups and application owners to resolve or escalate incidents quickly.

Key Technical Competencies:

- Application and Production Support (L1/L1.5)

- Monitoring and Observability Tools (Dynatrace, New Relic, AWS CloudWatch, etc.)
